The '''Vob system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vob]].

It was one of the only three systems in the Ktilac Regions open to outsiders, under strict conditions.
